ThingDef.label: goblin loincloth
ThingDef.description: A crude loincloth. It barely counts as clothing, which is exactly the point.

ThingDef.label: goblin rag wrap
ThingDef.description: A ragged body wrap used by goblins as everyday clothing.

ThingDef.label: goblin ritual shroud
ThingDef.description: A ritual shroud of cured human leather, wood splints, and bone charms.

ThingDef.label: goblin furry human-skin cloak
ThingDef.description: A heavier human-skin cloak padded with rough fur and trophy scraps.

ThingDef.label: goblin bone armor
ThingDef.description: Bone plates tied over the arms and chest. Light, ugly, and better than skin.

ThingDef.label: goblin wood light armor
ThingDef.description: Rough wooden armor bound with leather straps.

ThingDef.label: goblin wood heavy armor
ThingDef.description: Heavier wooden armor with crude reinforcement plates.

ThingDef.label: goblin chain-lamellar
ThingDef.description: Chain and lamellar plates made for quick goblin fighters.

ThingDef.label: goblin chestplate
ThingDef.description: A compact chestplate that favors torso protection over coverage.

ThingDef.label: goblin lamellar armor
ThingDef.description: Overlapping alloy scales. Flexible enough for raiders who still need to move.

ThingDef.label: goblin butcher plate
ThingDef.description: Brutish plate armor for close assault troops and butchers.

ThingDef.label: goblin composite armor
ThingDef.description: A patched composite armor meant for goblins who still need to move under fire.

ThingDef.label: goblin iron cuirass
ThingDef.description: Simple torso armor that trades arm coverage for low weight.

ThingDef.label: goblin heavy iron cuirass
ThingDef.description: Reinforced torso armor for raiders expected to hold the center.

ThingDef.label: goblin human-skin frame
ThingDef.description: A narrow wooden carrying frame used by goblin haulers and raiders.

ThingDef.label: goblin pheromone pack
ThingDef.description: A back-mounted jar frame packed with aged goblin guts and meat. When cracked open, it releases dense goblin pheromone gas. It is similar to goblin stinkbomb gas, but much stronger against non-goblins.

ThingDef.label: goblin squad banner
ThingDef.description: A back-mounted banner for squad leaders and oath-bound raiders.

ThingDef.label: goblin cultist skin mask
ThingDef.description: A crude ritual mask made to unsettle captives and impress other goblins.

ThingDef.label: goblin skull mask
ThingDef.description: A skull mask tied together with scraps of leather and wire.

ThingDef.label: goblin bone helmet
ThingDef.description: A heavier bone helmet assembled from scavenged bones.

ThingDef.label: goblin bird helmet A
ThingDef.description: A bird-like goblin helmet with a narrow beak-shaped face guard.

ThingDef.label: goblin bird helmet B
ThingDef.description: A reinforced bird helm with broader face protection.

ThingDef.label: goblin crude helmet A
ThingDef.description: A crude metal helmet hammered into shape without much patience.

ThingDef.label: goblin crude helmet B
ThingDef.description: A heavier crude helmet with more metal around the face.

ThingDef.label: goblin frogmouth helmet
ThingDef.description: A squat helmet with a narrow slit, good for keeping arrows out and sightlines terrible.

ThingDef.label: goblin hammer helmet
ThingDef.description: A helmet with a heavy brow and blunt impact plates.

ThingDef.label: goblin kettle helmet A
ThingDef.description: A simple kettle helmet shaped for goblin heads.

ThingDef.label: goblin kettle helmet B
ThingDef.description: A heavier kettle helmet with extra plates around the brow.

ThingDef.label: reinforced goblin kettle helmet
ThingDef.description: A reinforced kettle helmet for goblin line fighters.

ThingDef.label: goblin spike helmet
ThingDef.description: A spiked helmet meant to make charges look worse than they are.

ThingDef.label: goblin war helmet A
ThingDef.description: A close-assault helmet with aggressive face protection and poor sightlines.

ThingDef.label: goblin war helmet B
ThingDef.description: A lighter war helmet that keeps more visibility for shooters.
